_comment: The book's index: which volumes exist, which chapters sit in them, and in what order.
Chapter ids and titles are taken from docs/emi-desk/WAVE2-CONTRACT.md and are load-bearing:
the id is the chapter's filename in ./chapters/ and the payload of the codex:open bridge
message, so renaming one breaks the bookmark the host stored for it.
Volumes IV to VI are on the spine with no pages behind them, on purpose, so the shape of
the book is honest from day one. A volume with locked:true or an empty chapter list is drawn
as a padlocked tab and is skipped by reading progress.
A chapter entry may be a plain id string or an object with id and title. The title here is
what the spine and the chapter strip show before the chapter file has been read; once it
loads, the file's own title wins.
